claimed_by.role: repository maintainer and the author of the mapped implementation

what_this_file_proves: That whoever can commit to this repository also states, in the repository, which namespace the crosswalk is about.
Nothing else. A reader who needs cryptographic namespace ownership should require one of the proofs listed below; this file alone is a claim inside the namespace it claims.
what_this_file_does_not_prove: control of a DNS name (no TXT record is published)
control of an organisational account through OIDC
that the PyPI project uibc-core is published by the same party without checking the publisher record
stronger_proofs_a_registry_could_require: DNS: a TXT or HTTPS .well-known record served from the namespace's own domain
OIDC: a token issued by the identity provider that owns the namespace, presented at publish time
Registry-side: an account binding that a registry operator verifies once and records
note: Written because the vocabulary registry, like the MCP registry, treats namespace ownership as the thing a listing must not fake. Until one of the stronger proofs exists, a listing should describe this system as self-declared rather than verified.
